review.scope: Isolated EVEX entry with original executable/data object bytes and linked positions verified, four native compilers, eight frozen PE/ELF inputs, all three modes and both launch controls; 21 balanced cycles.
review.checksum_scope: Native tests compare boundaries and selected values; complete private-entry records were checked separately against baseline.

replication_protocol.scope: Repeat only logical workloads with a below-threshold observation or out-of-range identical-binary control. Preserve the original consumer and both launch methods, without changing source, code-byte or symbol-position gates. Keep all initial observations.
